prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory WUI decision support; continuity over automation when degraded; human confirmation always. Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): triage; marks radio route impaired on bridge failure (Orion ack); jurisdiction check before Drone Pilot Operator briefing; Crew Staging Pin to Helitack Crew Leader; promotes fire location to Redtail; assignment packages flagged on Confirmed Ignition State change; extended attack mode; disconnected mode (last-sync marking, cached review, queued updates, no irreversible releases); RBAC, MFA, expiring credentials on auth outage. Airspace Restricted State: helitack boundary confirmation before aircraft movement. North Lookout Camera Mast: smoke bearing, Thermal Spot Snippet to Orion. South Lookout Camera Mast: bearing, Camera Cleaning Log to Smoke Classifier Module. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): Battery Swap Ticket to Drone Pilot Operator. Drone Tasking Service: mission status, not flight-release authority, no Marigold lane conflict. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern): traceable recommendations, perimeter, probability bands, applies Ridge Shadow Mask, rejects unsigned models. Smoke Classifier Module: plume confidence to Lantern; produces Ridge Shadow Mask; never sole aircraft basis. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle): Wind Shift Bulletin to Redtail. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater (Badger): fallback relay, queues acks ≥15 min. Crewline Mobile Tablet: objectives, hazards, route; encrypted queue. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold): blocks incomplete releases; Runway Release Note (used by Tanker Base Manager in acceptance review); Suppression Drop Receipt (used by County Emergency Liaison in post-incident reconciliation). East Retardant Loading Pump: Retardant Batch Slip to Tanker Base Manager, metered recirculation mode; West: shift-change inspection. Security: least privilege, signed append-only audit, encryption. Training, exercises, metrics, proficiency before access. Deployment governance board (operations, maintenance, infosec, detection, aviation, ground crew, county reps) approves seasonal rollout after residual risk, staffing, baselines, open corrective actions review; waivers need impact, compensating procedure, expiry, owner. Acceptance: functional tests (Portal, Lantern, Classifier); availability/timing/data-quality (masts, Brindle); field validation of abort/status (Drone service, Dock); integration checks (Marigold, pumps); coverage/persistence/auth/degraded tests (Badger,

New part:
S239: Each after-action review shall reconstruct the timeline from system logs, user accounts, communications records, and maintenance notes without assigning blame to individual operators.
S240: Review facilitators shall document what was expected to happen, what actually happened, why differences occurred, and which corrective actions are necessary before the next readiness cycle.
S241: Corrective actions shall be entered into a controlled improvement backlog with assigned ownership, target completion dates, verification methods, and linkage to the originating event.
S242: Data stewardship shall define retention, access control, quality review, and disposition rules for operational records, sensor data, model outputs, configuration records, and user activity records.
S243: Operational data used for model evaluation shall be protected from unauthorized alteration and shall preserve enough context to support later engineering review and regulatory inquiry.
S244: Changes to the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine or Smoke Classifier Module shall be evaluated with representative seasonal data before deployment to confirm that detection performance improves without unacceptable increases in false alerts.
S245: Configuration changes to field equipment shall be versioned, reviewed, and tested in a nonoperational environment before being promoted into the seasonal baseline.
S246: At the end of each fire season, the governance board shall compare system performance, operational workload, maintenance burden, and user feedback against the acceptance criteria approved for that season.
S247: The resulting improvement plan shall define which procedures, training materials, interfaces, algorithms, and support arrangements will be revised before the next seasonal readiness campaign begins.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
